descripcion_html:
Upgrade Your Home with Vitachy’s Sustainable and Stylish Glass Spray Bottle Set.

Are you tired of flimsy plastic bottles that break easily and leach chemicals? It’s time to switch to a more professional, eco-friendly solution. Vitachy’s 16oz Amber Glass Spray Bottles are designed for those who value durability, functionality, and aesthetic appeal in their home or workspace.

Why Choose Vitachy Spray Bottles?

  • 🛡️ Superior Protection: Unlike standard glass bottles, our set features two premium silicone sleeves (Blue & Eucalyptus). These "boots" prevent cracks from accidental bumps and ensure the bottle stays put on slippery bathroom or kitchen tiles.
  • 🌿 Essential Oil Safe: Our high-grade amber glass blocks out light-sensitive UV rays. This ensures your essential oil mixtures, homemade cleaners, and aromatherapy blends stay potent and effective for longer.
  • 💧 Multi-Purpose Performance: The high-output trigger sprayer offers 3 settings: a gentle mist for indoor plants or hair, a targeted stream for tough stains, and a total-off lock for safety.
  • 🚫 Mess-Free Experience: No more sticky fingers. Each sprayer is fitted with a leak-proof gasket that prevents dripping, even when held at an angle, giving you a smooth and reliable spray every time.
  • 🏷️ Professional Organization: Included with your set are elegant chalkboard labels and a white marker. Easily label your DIY concoctions and keep your laundry room, garden, or salon organized and beautiful.

Infinite Uses for Every Room:
From misting tropical plants and iron-aiding to pet training and sanitizing surfaces, these reusable bottles are a versatile addition to any household.

What’s in the Box:
2x 16oz Amber Glass Bottles, 2x Protective Silicone Sleeves (Blue & Eucalyptus), 2x Heavy-Duty Sprayer Heads, Chalkboard Labels, and 1x Chalk Pen.

Join the zero-waste movement with Vitachy and add a touch of professional quality to your daily routine!
